create_carla_env: create a CarlaEnv instance with render display, weather changes, and multiple camera sensors
run_carla_step: run a single simulation step in CarlaEnv by applying a steer and throttle brake action
reset_carla_env: reset the CarlaEnv to spawn a new vehicle and clear previous actors and sensors
configure_weather: configure dynamic weather in CarlaEnv using the Weather class with sun and storm parameters
use_sync_mode: use CarlaSyncMode as a context manager to synchronize sensor data across simulation ticks
